description.value: Founded in 1975 and marking its 50th anniversary in 2025, the Centre culturel francophone de Vancouver is the anchor institution for French-language arts and culture in Metro Vancouver, presenting professional theatre, music, visual arts exhibitions, improv competitions, and an annual summer festival. It also runs a French-language library, language courses, and a summer camp, making it a full-service community hub rather than just a venue. The building houses the Café Salade de Fruit, a sit-down restaurant open most days, which adds practical value for visitors exploring the Kitsilano neighbourhood.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 13m; stands (4 spaces) at 28m; stands (2 spaces) at 37m; stands (5 spaces) at 85m; stands (2 spaces) at 91m. Total: 17 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website corroborates the OSM address (1551, West 7th Avenue, Vancouver, V6J 1S1) and phone number (604-736-9806), and active upcoming event listings confirm the centre is currently operating. The /infos-pratiques subpage explicitly names an on-site café, Café Salade de Fruit, with its own website. No content anywhere on the site addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cycling-specific amenities, so all those fields remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The centre is a well-established, active cultural attraction with an on-site café and broad community programming, making it a plausible listing for touring cyclists seeking cultural experiences; however, none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence and would require a site visit to assess.

Café or food on site.detail: Café Salade de Fruit operates on-site; confirmed on /infos-pratiques page with its own website listed as https://www.saladedefruits.com/
